introduction.title: Less deciding. More cooking.
paragraphs: vminds Meals brings meal suggestions, saved recipes, shopping lists, and guided cooking into one workflow. It connects the decision about what to eat with the practical steps of preparing it.

solution.title: The solution
paragraphs: Instead of treating recipe discovery, planning, and preparation as separate tasks, the application brings them together. AI-assisted suggestions provide a starting point, saved recipes help build a personal collection, and shopping lists connect meal choices to the ingredients needed.
Guided cooking carries the selected recipe into the kitchen, keeping preparation part of the same experience.
